## Description

Linearizes non-linear macroeconomic state-space equations using Koopman operator observable dictionaries, applying Model Predictive Control (MPC) to dynamically adjust portfolio risk exposure.

## Where it may fit

Macro regime shifts, interest rate shocks, multi-variable portfolio risk management.

## Vehicles

Global Macro Hedge Funds, Quantitative Multi-Asset Desks.

## Required data

Multi-variable macro indicator series, asset volatility matrices, interest rate curves.

## Caveats

Observable dictionary function expansion requires regularization to prevent curse of dimensionality.
